data.name: Connections.Body
data.value: Connect an external identity to your existing HTS account. Email access remains available.

data.name: Connections.Safety
data.value: A linked identity does not grant staff roles, Discord roles or server access. External sign-in must be enabled separately.

data.name: Return.Body
data.value: Continue in this browser to review the account and confirm. This step has not linked an account or signed you in yet.

data.name: Confirm.LinkBody
data.value: Only confirm if this external account belongs to you. It will be associated with your currently signed-in HTS account.

data.name: Confirm.LoginBody
data.value: Continue only if this is your external account. Sign-in works only when it is already linked to an HTS account.

data.name: Result.Failed
data.value: The connection could not be confirmed. Sign in by email and start again. Accounts are never merged automatically.

data.name: Result.Removed
data.value: Account unlinked. Email access remains available.

data.name: Connections.DirectoryPending
data.value: Waiting for the company directory adapter.

data.name: Connections.DiscordPrepared
data.value: Linking and sign-in are prepared for future activation.
